agent_findings.detail: The Source Crosswalk page no longer renders, and all 8 per-chapter 'Arabic source pp. X-Y' provenance lines are gone. Regenerated book/source-crosswalk.json is now a bare JSON array; readCrosswalk() in plan-dashboard/scripts/lib/book-html.mjs requires data.chapters and returns [] on a shape mismatch, so the page and the per-chapter lines are dropped silently. This, not the keep-with-next reflow, is the entire 122->121 page delta.

STILL LIVE once the page returns: the visible mid-word cut is renderSourceCrosswalk's (item.source_excerpt||'').slice(0,140) in book-html.mjs, not the 420-char Python cut. The new _excerpt() ellipsis is 280 characters past the cell's own slice, so cells would still print 'was struck by t'.
